releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.12.9 - Direct 40-50C Idle Thermal Lock:
- Enforced TempTamer active state in registry and app startup (disables aggressive 1.45V turbo boost at idle).
- Locked CPU to cool sub-1.0V base clock with EPP 80.
- Engaged proactive whisper fan cooling (~1600-1900 RPM) to keep idle temperatures at 40-48C.
- Routed all background/electron apps to AMD iGPU to eliminate 16.8W dGPU idle heat soak.
